role_in_parent: Rewrites the translated inequality back in the original variable.
statement_nl: For every positive integer n, every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, every real t with 0 <= t < 1, and every real x with x = T_{n,j}(t), one has G_{n,j}(t) = F_n(x), and moreover G_{n,j}(0) = F_n(j/n).

domain_restrictions: j is an integer with 0 <= j <= n - 1
t is a real with 0 <= t < 1 (in particular, t = 0 is allowed)
x is a real satisfying x = T_{n,j}(t)
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For every positive integer n and every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, and every real t with 0 <= t < 1, we have G_{n,j}(t) equals F_n applied to T_{n,j}(t); additionally, for the same n and j, we have G_{n,j}(0) equals F_n applied to j divided by n.
quantifier_order: for all n in positive integers
for all j in integers such that 0 <= j <= n - 1
for all t in reals such that 0 <= t < 1
for all x in reals such that x = T_{n,j}(t)

variables.name: n
variables.role: global parameter indexing F_n and the pair (T_{n,j}, G_{n,j})

variables.name: j
variables.role: indexing T_{n,j} and G_{n,j} and appearing in the fraction j/n

variables.name: x
variables.role: auxiliary variable constrained by x = T_{n,j}(t), used as input to F_n

witness_dependencies: x depends on (n, j, t) via the defining equation x = T_{n,j}(t)
